story.edition: CALIBRE M — AN ORIGINAL DESIGN STUDY
story.manifestoBody: A watch is more than the hour it tells. It is proportion, texture, movement. A small world, chosen to become part of yours.
story.caseBody: Polished edges meet a softly brushed case. Each surface is shaped to catch light differently.
story.dialBody: Applied markers, fine radial lines and a quiet composition. Detail reveals itself as you look closer.
story.heartBody: Follow the energy through the calibre. Wheels, bridges and bearings come together in a finely balanced conversation.
story.rhythm: The rhythm imagined for Calibre M
story.contoursBody: A softened silhouette. A precise edge. The expression of restraint, from every angle.
story.macroDialBody: Fine sunray texture gives the dial a subtle depth that changes with the light.
story.handsBody: A slender silhouette, a polished bevel, and a luminous centre.
story.bezelBody: A continuous frame, finished with a fine chamfer to gather the light.
story.profileBody: The case resolves into a slender edge. A finely knurled crown adds a tactile final detail.
story.strapBody: Supple leather, shaped at the lugs. A fine line of stitching follows its natural curve.
story.finishBody: One form. A different character in every finish.
